_meta.title: Sourced alias candidates for the two thinnest-coverage countries in the live registry -- companion to docs/research/canonical-entity-intelligence/09-existing-oryn-ambiguity-audit.md Finding 9
_meta.method: Every alias below is confirmed directly against ROR's live API (api.ror.org/v2/organizations) this session, using ROR's own 'names' field (types: ror_display, label, alias, acronym) as the evidence, not recalled from memory or guessed. Deliberately curated, not a raw ROR dump: ROR lists label variants in many languages (French, German, Catalan, Slovenian, etc.) that are unlikely to be what an ORYN student actually searches with -- only the native-language official name, well-known English form (where different from ORYN's current display_name), and unambiguous abbreviations are included below. Ambiguous or ROR-unconfirmed abbreviations were deliberately left out rather than guessed (e.g. 'RUG' for University of Groningen and 'UT' for University of Twente are both in common informal use but neither appears in ROR's own acronym field for that institution, so neither is included here).
_meta.alias_type_mapping: ORYN's entity_aliases.alias_type enum (02-alias-taxonomy.md): a native-language official name not currently stored is 'translation'; a ROR-confirmed acronym is 'abbreviation'; a well-known short/common English form that differs from the stored display_name (e.g. 'La Sapienza') is 'common'. Every row below states which.
_meta.scope_note: This is a candidate list for whoever has entity_aliases write access -- this research session has none. Every id below is the live canonical_entities.id, confirmed against the current registry, not assumed from a prior snapshot.
_meta.netherlands_coverage: 13/13 Dutch university entities researched -- full coverage of Finding 9's '0/13' gap.
_meta.italy_coverage: 12 of 38 Italian university entities researched (the highest-search-likelihood subset: the most internationally well-known institutions) -- not full coverage of the 38, a prioritized first batch.
